entries.name: MAX_ENVELOPE_BYTES
entries.definition: The largest serialised component envelope, in UTF-8 bytes of the compact JSON of its component and provenance.

entries.name: MAX_INTENT_BYTES
entries.definition: The largest serialised component intent a write accepts, in bytes.

entries.name: MAX_LINE_CHART_SERIES
entries.definition: The most series one line chart draws, the maxItems of the line_chart intent schema's select.

entries.name: MAX_POINTS_PER_SERIES
entries.definition: The most points, one per period at the frame's grain, one series draws.

entries.name: MAX_SELECTORS
entries.definition: The most selector values one component's select may resolve before grouping.

entries.name: MAX_SERIES_PER_COMPONENT
entries.definition: The most series one component draws.

entries.name: MAX_TABLE_ROWS
entries.definition: The most rows one table component holds, the series count times the period count.
